name: character_factory_flow
description: Supplied body to animated character in two agent-driven card stages: rig (rig card auto — SOMA-77 weights onto the body GLB path), motion (motion card kimodo — text-to-motion skinned onto the rigged mesh, somax bake in-graph). WHAT it produces: a rigged GLB plus an animated GLB (and its motion NPZ) from one body GLB path + one action line. The photo→mesh LIFT is not a stage: the lift's served producer is a terminal FILE_3D save no in-graph hop can carry, so the lift rides the img-to-mesh card door or the object-forge row, and its artifact path feeds this row's mesh initial (the run-chain). HOW agents drive it: stages are AGENT-DRIVEN card chains through the queue door ({model:} per card, or the bench); multi-stage drives at start through the {flow:} door (the curated-lane lift). Creature motion is NOT a stage — it rides the MOTION phase (unimate dataset clip through the game-profile MCPs, rig copy bridge), documented in the leaf skill.

mesh.description: Required. The body to rig — a GLB path (the initial gate's mesh kind): an anny bake, a TRELLIS/img-to-mesh lift artifact, an estimator body, any bare human mesh.

prompt.description: Required. What the body DOES — verb-first, one continuous action (kimodo text-to-motion). Same seed + prompt = same take.
